speaker: Patient
text: 42-year-old Caucasian male. The patient reports experiencing visible blood in his urine accompanied by discomfort in his right flank. He denies any recent trauma to the area. He mentions a series of urinary tract infections over the past few years but has not been on renal dialysis.

speaker: Patient

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Appearance - Reddish; WBC - 10-20 /HPF; RBC - Too numerous to count; Nitrites - Negative; Leukocyte_Esterase - Positive

speaker: Doctor
text: The urinalysis confirms significant hematuria and pyuria with a positive leukocyte esterase, but the negative nitrites make a standard bacterial UTI less likely. Given your history of recurrent infections, do you experience any night sweats, weight loss, or bone pain? REQUEST TEST: Urine Culture and Sensitivity.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urine Culture and Sensitivity: No significant bacterial growth noted; pending further evaluation for atypical organisms given clinical history.

speaker: Doctor
text: The urine culture showing no significant growth despite your recurrent infections and positive leukocyte esterase is concerning for an atypical pathogen or non-infectious cause. Given your history of recurrent UTIs, flank pain, and hematuria, do you have a history of tuberculosis exposure, or do you experience chronic cough and weight loss? REQUEST TEST: Urine AFB (Acid-Fast Bacilli) smear and culture.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urine AFB Smear: Negative; Urine AFB Culture: Negative; Urine AFB NAAT: Negative

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative urine AFB results across smear, culture, and NAAT effectively rule out urogenital tuberculosis. Since your urinalysis shows positive leukocyte esterase and pyuria without standard bacterial growth or TB, do you have any history of kidney stones, blood thinners, or recent vigorous exercise? REQUEST TEST: Renal Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Renal Ultrasound: Multiple cysts present in the collecting ducts of the medulla. No obstruction noted.

speaker: Doctor
text: The renal ultrasound findings of multiple cysts in the collecting ducts of the medulla are highly characteristic of Medullary Sponge Kidney. Given your history of recurrent infections and hematuria, this structural abnormality likely predisposes you to stone formation and stasis. Do you have a history of passing kidney stones or experiencing colicky pain? DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney
